PhentiBuild Reference Markers

The Camera Scanner measures by finding one of these black-and-white markers in the photo. Because the app knows the marker's exact printed size, it can work out the real size of anything lying on the same surface, and correct for the camera angle.

Print them correctly
  1. Click Print. Choose Actual size / 100% scale (not "Fit to page"). Page 1 has four small cards, page 2 the large wall sheet.
  2. Check with a ruler: the card's black square must be exactly 36 mm, the sheet's exactly 150 mm. If not, the measurements will be wrong.
  3. Glue a card to stiff cardboard so it stays flat. Keep the white border around the square clean - the scanner needs it.
Measure
  1. Timber: lay a card flat on the piece. Walls: tape the A4 sheet flat on the wall - the bigger marker is far more precise.
  2. Photograph so the whole piece or wall is in the shot, as straight-on as you can, in good light.
  3. In the app, tap the two ends of the timber, or the four corners of the wall. You can drag the points to adjust them.

Page 2 - A4 marker sheet (for walls)

PhentiBuild

Wall marker sheet

The black square must measure exactly 150 mm on each side. Check with a ruler.

Tape it flat on the wall you are measuring, then photograph the whole wall.

Keep the white border around the square clean and uncovered.
